sets.nombre: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening DX

logros.descripcion: Listen to the secret song on the File Select Screen.
Acquire the Level-1 Shield from Tarin.
Acquire the Level-1 Sword from Toronbo Shores.
Without ever entering the screen where you acquire the Mushroom, use Magic Powder on the raccoon in the Mysterious Forest.
Find the sleepy mushroom in the Mysterious Forest.
Get Magic Powder for the first time.
See all dialogue options available from a transformed Buzz Blob without changing screens.
Pick up either the Guardian Acorn or Triangle of Power, then while one is active, pick up the other.
Get the Tail Key.
Acquire the Roc's Feather.
Defeat Moldorm without being harmed.
Acquire the Full Moon Cello from the Tail Cave.
Purchase bombs.
In the room left of the entrance inside the Tail Cave, kill the two Hardhat Beetles simultaneously.
Enter every room in Tail Cave.
Get every item from the Trendy Game in one visit and ask the owner for more.
Catch every fish in the Fishing Pond in one round, and immediately try to fish anyway without leaving the scene.
Provoke a Cucco attack.
Agree to be photographed.
Keep refusing to be photographed.
Rescue Bow-Wow damageless without equipping Roc's Feather or the Shield. Exit and re-enter the area to retry.
Acquire the Level 1 Power Bracelet.
Defeat Genie without being harmed.
Acquire the Conch Horn from the Bottle Grotto.
Enter every room in Bottle Grotto.
Have Bow-Wow eat all 15 enemies in Goponga Swamp without getting hit or pressing A or B. Exit and re-enter the area to retry.
Purchase some Secret Medicine.
Get the Magic Powder capacity upgrade from the Mad Batter.
Collect a treasure sniffed out by Bow-Wow.
Have Richard kick you out because you brought Bow-Wow with you.
Chase off Kiki the Monkey with Bow-Wow.
Purchase a shovel.
Collect the 5 Golden Leaves without losing health. Exit and re-enter through either castle entrance to retry.
Trigger Totaka's Song in Richard's house.
Get the Slime Key without taking damage. To retry, enter and exit the cave at the start of the Pothole Field interior.
Talk to a talking tree.
Acquire the Pegasus Boots.
Defeat Slime Eye without being harmed.
Acquire the Sea Lily's Bell from the Key Cavern.
Enter every room in Key Cavern.
Obtain 7 Heart Containers.
Defeat the four ghosts in the top-right section of the Graveyard.
Defeat Evil Orb without being harmed.
Acquire the Red Clothes or the Blue Clothes from the Color Dungeon.
Enter every room in the Color Dungeon.
Complete the Dream Shrine by opening both chests in one visit without taking damage.

logros.nombre: Date Night - A Walk on the Beach
logros.descripcion: Read Marin's note, find her at the beach, and take her to a scenic cliff in one session. Don't go to the cliff without Marin!

logros.nombre: Date Night - All Is Not Well
logros.descripcion: Jump into the Well with Marin.

logros.nombre: Date Night - An Afternoon at the Windmill
logros.descripcion: While at the Windmill, dig a hole, play the Ocarina, and get your photo taken with Marin in one session.

logros.nombre: Date Night - Gotta Be Strong For Your Woman
logros.descripcion: See all of the different reactions Marin has when you exit a dungeon in one session.

logros.nombre: Date Night - Women Love Bad Boys
logros.descripcion: See all dialogue for breaking pots, opening drawers, and hitting cuckoos with Marin in one session.

logros.nombre: Date Night - This Girl's a Pro!
logros.descripcion: Watch Marin play the Trendy Game
Travel through the Yarna Desert and get the Angler Key without taking damage. Exit and re-enter the desert to retry.
Talk to some skeletal remains in the Yarna Desert.
Have the Walrus resurface with a familiar song after having woken him up.
See all the dialogue of the Hippo in Animal Village without leaving the house.
Get the Boss Key in the Angler's Tunnel without having the Flippers.
Acquire the Flippers.
Defeat Angler Fish without being harmed.
Acquire the Surf Harp from the Angler's Tunnel.
Enter every room in Angler's Tunnel.
Get the Bomb capacity upgrade from the Mad Batter.
Take the Ghost to his house and his grave in one session.
Sprinkle some Magic Powder on the Ghost's grave.
Purchase the Bow.

logros.nombre: Am I Not Supposed to Use These?
logros.descripcion: Win the first encounter with Master Stalfos by using Bomb Arrows and pick up the small key. Reset to retry.
Defeat the final three encounters with Master Stalfos in Catfish's Maw without taking damage during- and between the fights. Bomb Arrows are NOT allowed.

logros.nombre: Mini-Boss Masher - Gohma and the Music Man
logros.descripcion: Defeat both Gohmas without taking damage while armed with only an Ocarina and a Bow. You must play the Ocarina at least once.
Acquire the Hookshot.
Defeat Slime Eel without being harmed.
Acquire the Wind Marimba from the Catfish's Maw.
Enter every room in Catfish's Maw.

logros.nombre: Inspector Link Is on the Case!
logros.descripcion: Acquire the Magnifying Lens by completing the Trading Sequence.
Acquire the Boomerang.
Collect 100 Rupees in the Raft Game.
Obtain the Face Key without taking damage in either the outside or inside sections of the Ancient Ruins.
Discover the truth behind the Island.
Acquire the Level 2 Power Bracelet.
Defeat the 3 Pol's Voices in the Face Shrine with the Ocarina.
Defeat Facade without being harmed.
Acquire the Coral Triangle from the Face Shrine.
Enter every room in Face Shrine.
Learn all 3 Ocarina songs.
Revive the Flying Rooster.
Obtain all 5 Dungeon Keys.

logros.nombre: The Chests of Tal Tal Mountain
logros.descripcion: Open all five of the treasure chests located on one screen on Tal Tal Mountain.

logros.nombre: The Great Fairies of Koholint Island
logros.descripcion: Heal yourself at all four Great Fairy locations in one session.
Talk to every owl statue on the island in one session.
Acquire the Mirror Shield.
Defeat the Grim Creeper in Eagle's Tower damageless.
Defeat Evil Eagle without being harmed.
Acquire the Organ of Evening Calm from the Eagle's Tower.
Enter every room in Eagle's Tower.
Get the Arrow capacity upgrade from the Mad Batter.
Acquire the Magic Rod.
Collect every Map, Compass, and Stone Beak in all nine dungeons.
Find all four Warp locations.
Defeat Hot Head without being harmed.
Acquire the Thunder Drum from Turtle Rock.
Enter every room in Turtle Rock.
Obtain all 14 Heart Containers.
Kill every animal in Mabe Village without leaving the village.
Collect all possible 26 Secret Seashells across Koholint.
Acquire the Level-2 Sword.
Complete the Photo Album.
Complete the overworld map.
Hold 999 Rupees at once.
Defeat all 6 Shadow Nightmares without being harmed.
Wake the Wind Fish from his slumber.
Help Marin fulfill her dream by finishing the adventure without dying once.
